displayName: Cloud Run for the Flutter web app
summary: Serves the web app from Cloud Run behind Firebase Hosting, for when the site needs server-side routes or secrets: a three-stage image ending in scratch, a Dart server with the SPA fallback and security headers, Terraform for the service, registry and secrets, a deploy that checks a revision before it takes traffic, rollback, and secret values set from standard input.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.

region.label: Region
region.help: The Google Cloud region the application runs in, e.g. asia-southeast1 for Singapore.

namePrefix.label: Resource name prefix
namePrefix.help: Short, lower case, e.g. acme. Prefixes every resource, so two applications in one project do not collide.

nextSteps: cd server && dart pub get && dart analyze && dart test
cd infra && terraform init && terraform apply
